value.rationale: The sharp L2→L4 finite-field Fourier extension norm on a natural one-dimensional split quadratic surface is a concrete structural gap in a recent sharp-restriction program. This result gives all odd prime powers including nonprime fields, a full positive-dimensional extremizer family beyond mere constant functions, and an exact global deficit split into mass dispersion, pair imbalance, pairwise magnitude defect and phase decoherence. This resolves an intrinsically motivated best-constant problem, not arbitrary small-parameter computation.
